company.description: pas-sport, is changing the sports industry in the Middle East by introducing the opportunity of sports scholarships to all the talented athletes. Our mission is to ensure talented athletes in the region maximize their athletic and academic potential, regardless of socioeconomic status, by receiving financial and educational support to access opportunities they would not have pursued or perhaps afforded – namely a United States college education through a sports scholarship.We aim to develop our product and service mix in order to continue supporting athletes throughout their full athletic lifecycle –from their junior sporting years all the way to their professional career.
